pretreatments.description: Biological pretreatment (joint action of native microbiota: Clostridium, Lactobacillus, and Enterobacter hydrolyzing xylan into volatile fatty acids)
Enzymatic pretreatment (Cellulase 50XL enzyme cocktail at 293 EGU/g of bagasse in 50 mM citrate buffer pH 6, releasing glucose, galactose, arabinose, and other sugars)
Dilute acid pretreatment (1.8 % HCl under soft operating conditions, solubilizing xylan and partially cellulose, generating furfural, hydroxymethylfurfural, and phenols)
Steam explosion pretreatment (plug flow reactor coupled to a flask tank, depressurization generating furfural and hydroxymethylfurfural)
